# McAfee Institute Insights

> A comprehensive OSINT, cyber intelligence, and digital forensics training hub offering professional certifications and career advancement resources.

McAfee Institute Insights provides specialized training in open-source intelligence (OSINT), cyber investigations, and digital forensics for law enforcement, cybersecurity professionals, and intelligence analysts. The platform features certification programs like CECI (Certified Expert in Cyber Investigations) and CPCI, alongside success stories and intelligence analysis resources.

## Key Topics

- OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence)
- CECI (Certified Expert in Cyber Investigations)
- Digital Forensics
- SOCMINT (Social Media Intelligence)
- AI in Investigations
- Cyber Intelligence
- Law Enforcement Training
- Professional Certifications
- Career Advancement
- Intelligence Analysis
- Cybersecurity
- Blockchain & Bitcoin
- Joshua McAfee
- Emerging Technologies
- CPCI Certification
